newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU TO SCRUTINISE RENAULT AID REQUEST.
newsitem.headline: EU TO SCRUTINISE RENAULT AID REQUEST.

text.p: The European Commission said on Thursday it would closely scrutinise a request by French carmaker Renault for half a billion Belgian francs in regional aid for its operations in Spain.
"We will look at this type of dossier in great detail," said Willy Helin, spokesman for the EU's competition commissioner Karel Van Miert.
Helin said Renault -- which announced plans at the weekend to close its Vilvoorde plant in Belgium with the loss of more than 3,000 jobs -- had recently requested aid for its Spanish operation.
Helin said these requests were always studied closely but this case had obvious current relevance.
"Were it confirmed that this (aid request) would amount to a transfer from one viable operation to another, we would take an even closer look than normal," he said. -- Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800
